modules.name: MLB
modules.summary: Phase-1 complete reference module for the shared Syndicate board contract with cards, game detail, live lens, a daily archive, season betting-card surfaces, and stabilized shared rank-board API transport across the main ranked MLB views.
modules.next_step: Keep MLB stable as the reference module, and only extract shared board helpers where multiple migrated sports now prove the abstraction without weakening artifact-backed browser parity.

modules.name: NBA
modules.summary: Source-backed cards, picks, live-lens, season betting-card flows, a real hub, and a stored-date daily archive now sit under the MLB-shaped public contract.
modules.next_step: Keep reducing source-specific glue only where it does not weaken browser parity, and only add deeper historical surfaces where stored-date artifacts already exist.

modules.name: NHL
modules.summary: NHL now has source-backed cards and game drill-in surfaces in Syndicate, plus ranked picks, a first season betting-card lane, a real hub, a real live-lens board, and a stored-date daily archive lane projected from the same daily snapshot files.
modules.next_step: Keep deepening NHL only with real stored-date consumers, now that the betting-card companion and archive lane can both prove historical workflows before broader season shells.

modules.name: NFL
modules.phase: Cards + game + grouped picks + betting card
modules.summary: NFL now has source-backed cards and a game drill-in in Syndicate, alongside grouped weekly picks, source-style picks payload aliases, and a season betting-card companion built from the same stored snapshot lane.
modules.next_step: Keep NFL stable as the next module-family completion candidate, and only reopen the weekly snapshot family if a focused payload or view audit turns up a real artifact-backed gap before broader season or live shells.

modules.name: WNBA
modules.summary: WNBA now exposes shared cards, picks, props, game detail, a real hub, a first season betting-card lane, MLB-style live-lens routes, and a stored-date daily archive lane in Syndicate.
modules.next_step: Keep replacing fallback-heavy slices with richer processed views and historical lanes where repeated stored dates already exist, now that the betting-card companion can share the same stored-date contract.

modules.name: NCAAF
modules.summary: NCAAF now has artifact-backed weekly cards, game drill-ins, picks, and a season betting-card companion in Syndicate, built from stored recommendation summaries while the live source feed is offseason-empty.
modules.next_step: Decide when to replace the offseason artifact-backed board with the source app's live primary workflow once populated slate data is available again.

modules.name: NCAAB
modules.phase: Cards + game + live lens + historical lane
modules.summary: NCAAB now has source-backed cards, a first game drill-in, a read-only live-lens board, a real-data season review, a historical betting-card companion, and a daily archive in Syndicate, lifted from the source app's recommendations, results, and live scoreboard workflows.
modules.next_step: Keep tightening the NCAAB historical lane now that season review, a betting-card companion, and the daily archive all share the same settled-date workflow.
